bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; providing that the vice-chair of the Legislative Coordinating Commission alternates between the senate and house of representatives every two years; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 3.303, subdivision 3.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 3.303, subdivision 3, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
Chair[+ and vice-chair+].
The chair of the commission alternates between the president of the senate and the speaker of the house [-of representatives-] at the start of the regular legislative session in each odd-numbered year.[+ When not serving as chair, the president of the senate or the speaker of the house serves as vice-chair. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; providing that the vice-chair of the Legislative Coordinating Commission alternates between the senate and house of representatives every two years; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 3.303, subdivision 3.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 3.303, subdivision 3, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
Chair and vice-chair.
The chair of the commission alternates between the president of the senate and the speaker of the house at the start of the regular legislative session in each odd-numbered year. When not serving as chair, the president of the senate or the speaker of the house serves as vice-chair.
additions: When not serving as chair, the president of the senate or the speaker of the house serves as vice-chair.
